voci.d: How long will the safety measures last?
voci.r: All the safety rules are subject to changes without notice, according to the evolution of the situation.

voci.d: Can I book with confidence?
voci.r: We’d like to put your mind at ease about traveling once again, so even in the post-pandemic time, we would like to make sure you feel confident regarding our maximum flexibility. You can change your plans, for whatever reason.

voci.d: Can I change my tour date for free?
voci.r: You can change your service date for free.

voci.d: Can I convert my payment to a credit for free?
voci.r:
If you don’t know exactly when you’ll be able to travel in the future, convert your existing payments to credit. This way you will not lose your money due to cancellation fees. 

We will keep your money safe and you’ll be able to re-book your tour until December 2024.

voci.d: Can I transfer my credit?
voci.r: You can transfer your credit to a friend or family member, at no extra cost.

voci.d: Can I cancel my booking for free?
voci.r: If there is no other option than to cancel, we want to make sure you know we have the most flexible and super friendly cancellation & refund policy in the market: you can cancel for free up to 24 hours prior to your departure time.

voci.d: When can I cancel my booking?
voci.r: You can cancel your booking for free up to 24 hours prior to the departure time. For any cancellations with less than 24 hours notice or no show, no refund will be made. Bookings made within the 24-hour window are final and cannot be amended/canceled.

voci.d: How can I cancel my booking?
voci.r: Simply send us an email at usa@prestigerent.com, or give us a call at +39 055286059. If you booked through a third-party vendor (Viator, TripAdvisor, GetYourGuide, Musement, etc.) you must cancel directly with them, we cannot cancel/refund a booking made/paid to others.

voci.d: I've reserved a tour but I'm not sure I'll be able to travel for the booked date, do you suggest to cancel or convert the booking to a credit??
voci.r: If you don’t know the new date, but you are sure you will travel to Italy in the future, we suggest to covert the paid amount to a credit, to be used for future reservations. You can also transfer your credit to a friend or family member at no extra cost.

voci.d: Can I change my tour date?
voci.r: You can change your tour date for free if there is availability, up to 24 hours prior to the departure time. Bookings made within the 24-hour window are final and cannot be amended/canceled.

voci.d: Can I add other persons to my booking?
voci.r: Please contact us as soon as possible, so we can do our best to accommodate your request according to our availability.

voci.d: How can I amend my booking?
voci.r: Simply send us an email at usa@prestigerent.com or call us at +39 055286059. If you booked through a third-party vendor, you must contact them directly.

voci.d: I've booked my tour through Viator, TripAdvisor, GetYourGuide, etc. how can I amend my booking?
voci.r: You must address your amendment request directly to your vendor, because we are not able to amend something you have reserved through others.

voci.d: I've cancelled my prepaid tour, will you refund me?
voci.r: Yes. If your tour has been cancelled at least 24 hours prior to your tour departure, you will be refunded according to our cancellation policy.

voci.d: I've cancelled my prepaid tour, how long does it take to have my money back?
voci.r: It depends on the banks/credit card company. Our administrative dept processes the refund as soon as we receive the cancellation request.

voci.d: How does a refund work?
voci.r: The amount will be refunded on your credit/debit card or the PayPal/Bank account used for the payment.

voci.d: I've cancelled my tour booked through Viator, TripAdvisor, GetYourGuide, etc. how can I be refunded?
voci.r: You have to directly contact your vendor, because we are not able to manage the payments/refunds for bookings made from another platform (third parties).

voci.d: What happens if I arrive at the meeting point late and the tour has departed?
voci.r:
We cannot hold the tour for late arrivals because it would be disrespectful to the other guests. If you need additional info on how to get to the meeting point, contact us in advance, and not at the last minute, as it could be too late. 

If you show up late, don’t show up,  or you can’t find the meeting point for any reason, refunds will NOT be issued.

It’s not possible to join the group after it has started. Arriving at the right check-in time or a few minutes earlier, is the best way to enjoy the experience from the beginning, maintaining the good mood of the group.

voci.d: Are the prices for Private Tours/Transfers, per party or per person?
voci.r: The prices for Private Services (Tours, Transfers, Cruise Port Tours) are per party and vary depending on your party size. On each tour page, you will find a price section (tab) with specified rates.

voci.d: Are the Small Group Tours prices, per party or per person?
voci.r: The prices for Small Group Tours are per person and vary depending on the participant’s age. The default price is per adult,  and decreases for children/youth. On each small group tour page, you will find a price section with specified rates. If during the booking process you do not find an age category (i.e. infant) it is because infants are not allowed on that specific tour.

voci.d: The Private Tour to Siena and San Gimignano from Florence shows a price of Euro 550.00, but when I try to book for my party of 4 people, it changes to Euro 700.00, why?
voci.r:
Our prices for Private Services are per party and vary depending on your party size, this is why you can read “from Euro…”

Please select your date to see the price for your party size or visit the prices tab of the page to see the complete price list for parties of up to 8 people. For parties of 9+ people, please contact us.

voci.d: I'm trying to book a Private Tour/Transfer/Cruise Port Tour for my party of 9+ people, but I cannot find the price
voci.r: If you are a party of 9+ people, please contact us and we will reply with a specific price estimate.

voci.d: What is included/not included on your Private Tours?
voci.r:
Our Private Tours/Cruise Port Tours/Transfers Tours include:

  • Door-to-door service with pick up and drop off where needed
  • A professional and knowledgeable English speaking driver
  • Transportation with fully equipped Mercedes Benz vehicle, with free WiFi
  • All taxes, tolls and gasoline
  • No hidden costs or strange last-minute surcharges. 
 
Not included (unless booked as an optional, and specified on your confirmation voucher):
  • Entrance fees (if applicable)
  • Local guides on sites
  •  Meals, wine tastings and personal customer expenses
 

In order to avoid misunderstandings, make sure what you are buying matches your exact needs. Each tour page clearly specifies what is included and not as well as the available optionals.

voci.d: What is included/not included on your Small Group Tours?
voci.r: Each tour page specifies what is included and not. Being a group tour you cannot customize it, so optionals are not available.

voci.d: What optional can I add to my Private Tour?
voci.r: Add an optional to your private experience means to customize it to suit your needs. It could be the entrance fees for the Accademia Gallery, a local guide in Siena, or a wine tasting and lunch at a Tuscan winery, etc. or simply nothing because you like the comfort of a private service, but you prefer to make the other arrangements on your own.

voci.d: Is gratuity included in the price?
voci.r:
Tips are never included in our prices, because it is not mandatory in Italy. They are very much appreciated by drivers and guides and normally people leave between 10% to 20%.

However, the decision is up to you.

voci.d: Do you offer discounts?
voci.r: We can consider a discount if you book 2 or more tours with us, (e.g. you are on a ship and you book 3 tours from 3 ports of call with us). Please contact us and we will give you our best offer.

voci.d: Do you offer discounts/commissions to Travel Agencies?
voci.r: Yes, we do. Please contact us for more details.

voci.d: Do you offer discounts for children/youth?
voci.r:
The prices for private services (Private Tours, Transfers, Cruise Port Tours) are per party and not per person, so there is no difference if your party includes children/youth. 

As for our Small Group Tours, the price is per person and includes discounts for children and youth. Please check the price section for more details.

voci.d: Where can I find a discount/coupon code?
voci.r: In case you are eligible for a discount code, our customer care team will provide it directly to you.

voci.d: What payment methods do you accept?
voci.r: On our website you can pay using PayPal, MasterCard, Visa or Amex. Booking over the phone or chat you can pay via Visa or MasterCard only.

voci.d: Is my payment safe on your website?
voci.r: Your payment is 100% secure because the transactions is made directly on the bank/gateway page.

voci.d: Can I pay in cash, directly on the day of service?
voci.r: For private services only, you can pay cash (Euro currency), directly to the driver at the end of the day, and at the time of booking, you will be requested to provide your credit card details, just to secure your booking (no charge will be made on it).

voci.d: Can I pay cash in a different currency?
voci.r: Unfortunately, no. In order to avoid misunderstandings/complaints about the exact exchange rate and the commissions, we only accept payments in Euro.

voci.d: Can I pay by credit card directly on the day of the service?
voci.r: Unfortunately not! The POS (card reader) does not work correctly due to unstable mobile connection, it’s difficult to get the line. In the future, with the upgrading of the mobile connection we will be able to offer this option.

voci.d: Do you suggest to pay in advance by credit card or cash on the day?
voci.r: It is totally up to you. If you don’t mind carrying cash, the reason why cash would be better is that, in case of your cancellation, you don’t need to wait to get your money credited back to your card/account.

voci.d: How can I choose the right tour for my party?
voci.r: On each tour page, you can find all the details of the service such as tour type, duration, highlights, itinerary, and any additional info; however if you need any help/suggestions we are at your disposal.

voci.d: What is the difference between a Private Tour and a Small Group Tour?
voci.r:
Private means just for you, so your party will be the only one in the vehicle, and you can customize all the details of your service, to perfectly suit your needs. As you can imagine, a private service is the top in terms of safety, comfort, flexibility, privacy, etc.

 

A Small Group Tour is a shared tour; you book your spaces, and you go with the other participants. All the details of the service (max group size, departure time/location, itinerary, duration, inclusions, price per person, etc.) are clearly specified on the tour page, and cannot be modified to suit your specific needs.

voci.d: How can I book a Tour or Transfer?
voci.r: The easiest way is through our website, where you can check the real-time availability and pay on a secure server. If you prefer you can call/chat with our customer care team, we are always at your complete disposal for any further questions.

voci.d: Can I book via email, phone or chat?
voci.r: Whatever is more convenient for you, is good for us, but please keep in mind we are based in Italy and under CET/CEST time.

voci.d: When will I receive the voucher confirming my booking?
voci.r: You should expect to receive an email within minutes from the booking with your confirmation voucher.

voci.d: I've not received the email containing my confirmation voucher
voci.r: Check if our email is in your spam folder and if not, contact us! Please note: during the booking procedure be careful when you enter your email address, the confirmation voucher will automatically be sent to the email provided.

voci.d: I've received my voucher, but it contains wrong details
voci.r: The voucher is a document automatically generated with the info that you filled out during the booking procedure. The first thing to do is to double-check that all the details are correct. If not, please advise us as soon as possible so we can make all the changes needed in order to avoid misunderstandings.

voci.d: I've booked my tour through Viator, TripAdvisor, GetYourGuide, etc. but I didn't received my confirmation voucher or the info is incorrect
voci.r: You must contact and clarify the issue directly with your vendor, because we are not able to help you on this.

voci.d: Error message during the booking procedure
voci.r: If during the procedure you encounter an error such as a blank page etc., simply contact us so we can assist you, and complete the reservation.

voci.d: How can I be sure that my booking has been successfully completed?
voci.r:
Once your booking has been successfully received by our system, you will receive, within minutes, the automatic confirmation email, containing your confirmation voucher, with all the details of your purchase.

If you didn’t receive it, something went wrong, so please contact us.

voci.d: When do you run your tours?
voci.r:
We run our private services (Tours, Cruise Port Tours, Transfers, etc.) 365 days a year, according to our availability, which can be checked on our website, or by contacting our customer care center. 

 

As for our Small Group Tours, during the high season they run daily (or twice a day for the half day Wine Experience Tour). The only way to know the exact info is to verify the calendar on the tour page, that shows real-time availability.

voci.d: Is an advanced booking necessary?
voci.r: To be sure about the availability, advance booking is mandatory.

voci.d: How far in advance should I book?
voci.r: Thanks to our popularity we receive a lot of requests, so we highly recommend you to book the earliest possible.

voci.d: Can I book at the last minute?
voci.r: Last-minute booking requests are welcome, according to our availability you can check on our website. For last-minute reservations (less than 48 hours), especially for private tours and transfers we highly recommend to give us a call.

voci.d: Why is the date I'm interested in not available on your website?
voci.r:
Our website shows real time availability, it happens when the specific tour is sold out. In this case you can check alternative dates, or contact us to double check if other guests have cancelled at the last minute.

 

 

Small group tours can be booked until departure time. For private tours/transfers, we have a cut off time of 24/48 hours, because we need time to arrange them. For last minute requests (less than 48 hours), please give us a call and we will do our best to help you out.

voci.d: How to browse the website
voci.r:
Using the main menu you can search for the service you are interested in two different ways. Browsing by the type of service (Small Group Tours, Private Tours, Cruise Port Tours, Transfers, etc.), then selecting the location (the departure place from where you want to use the service) of your interest.

 Or vice-versa, selecting your destination and then the service type you are looking for.

voci.d: How to find my Small Group Tour
voci.r:
Simply click on the Small Group Tours and select the one that you prefer. Or click on Destinations, Florence & Tuscany and Small Group Tours. 

Please note: since we only offer Small Group Tours from Florence, the easiest way to reach the tours is by clicking directly on the Small Group Tours link.

voci.d: How to find my Private Tour
voci.r:
During your stay in Rome, if you’d like to book a Private Tour of Pompei and the Amalfi Coast for example, you can click on “Private Tours”, then select your destination (Rome) and the “Private Tour of Pompei and Amalfi Coast”.

Same result is if you click on “Destinations”, “Rome”, “Private Tours” and then “Pompei and the Amalfi Coast”.

voci.d: How to find my Cruise Port Tour
voci.r:
Your cruise ship will dock at Livorno Port and you want to book a Cruise Port Tour to visit Florence and Pisa. 

You can click on “Cruise Port Tours“, then select your destination (that is Livorno Port) and from the page with all the tours from Livorno Port, select the one to Florence and Pisa. 

The same result can be reached starting with “Destinations“, then “Livorno Port“ and then the tour of your interest.

voci.d: How to find my Transfer or Transfer Tour
voci.r:
From “Transfers” you can access “Direct Transfers” (point A to point B) and “Transfer Tours” (point A to point B with a stop en route). 

Let’s just say you want to book a Transfer Tour between Florence and Rome (or Rome to Florence) with a stop in Siena. You can click on “Transfers”, “Transfer Tours”, then “Florence to Rome” and select the one with the stop in Siena.

Please note: Transfers or Transfer Tours have the same itinerary; either you start from point A to arrive at B or vice versa.

voci.d: How to find my Tour of Italy
voci.r:
From “Tours of Italy“ you can see a few suggestions for multi-day tours through Italy. 

 

We highly recommend that you complete the customer form request. The more details you give us on your trip and what you prefer to do, the more we can help you build the perfect vacation in Italy.

voci.d: Where is the meeting (start) point of your small group tours?
voci.r:
All our small group tours depart from Piazzale Montelungo (Montelungo Square), close to the Florence Santa Maria Novella Train Station (the main station of Florence).
Find detailed directions on your confirmation voucher.

voci.d: What is the meeting (check-in) time?
voci.r: The check-in is 15 minutes prior to the tour departure. The exact check-in time is on your confirmation voucher.

voci.d: What time should I arrive at the meeting point?
voci.r: The check-in time is 15 minutes prior to the tour departure. If you are not familiar with the area allow plenty of time.

voci.d: How can I recognize my guide at the meeting point?
voci.r: Look for a red flag with the Prestige Rent logo on it and the check-in table

voci.d: I'm at the meeting point but I cannot find the guide
voci.r: If you are at the right time/place you should easily recognize our guides; however in the very rare case you cannot see your guide, give us a call at +39055286059 and we will help you.

voci.d: Does the meeting point have facilities (bar, food, restroom, etc.)?
voci.r: No, it is just a bus terminal with no services. If you need to use the restrooms, take a coffee, etc,  please do it in advance.

voci.d: Can I join the tour en-route (not at the meeting point)?
voci.r: Unfortunately, no! There are strict rules about where tour operators are authorized to start/end the tour, so intermediate stops for pick-up/drop-off are prohibited.

voci.d: I'm driving to the meeting point, can I park my car nearby?
voci.r: In front of the meeting point there is a parking lot. We suggest you arrive beforehand because there could be very bad traffic in Florence and the parking lot could be full and you may need to find an alternative parking.

voci.d: What is the maximum number of participants on your small group tours?
voci.r:
Our small group tours run with max 25 participants

Standard group tours run with 60+ people.

voci.d: Why do you consider 25 people a Small Group Tour?
voci.r:
After thousands of interviews with our clients, we discovered that the majority consider that 25 people is the limit to maintain a high level of comfort and quality. We know for a fact that our small group wine experience has been ranked #1 in the top 10 wine tours in the world by Tripadvisor clients.

Last but not least, you have to consider that most of our competitors run their standard tours with 60+ participants. If you prefer more privacy and flexibility or to customize your itinerary, you can choose one of our private day trips just for you and your party.

voci.d: Do you require a minimum number of participants to run your Small Group Tours?
voci.r: Yes, we do. Each tour runs with a minimum of 4/6 participants depending on the tour. Exact details on each tour page.

voci.d: What happens if the minimum number of participants is not reached?
voci.r: If the tour does not reach the minimum number of people to run, (very rare occurance), you’ll be offered a different date, an alternative tour (according to our availability) or a full refund.

voci.d: I have lots of luggage, will my vehicle have enough room?
voci.r: Normally we assign a vehicle considering each passenger will have one suitcase and one small carry-on. Please let us know in advance the amount of luggage you will be carrying, to be sure they fit into the assigned vehicle. We are not responsible for excess luggage unless you’ve specified it at the time of reservation.

voci.d: I'm travelling with my wheelchair/electric scooter/etc.
voci.r: Please specify it at the time of reservation, so we can check the availability of the right size vehicle.

voci.d: I'm travelling with my bike/golf equipment/ski/etc.
voci.r: If you bring anything that is not a standard suitcase/carry-on/handbag, you must specify it when you reserve, so we can give you the proper vehicle.

voci.d: It's raining, is my Private/Small Group Tour, still running?
voci.r: Yes. Our tours (Private and Small Group) run rain or shine, please dress appropriately. In the very rare case of extremely bad weather, we must cancel your tour. You will be advised as soon as possible and be offered a suitable alternative or a full refund.

voci.d: Do you have a dress code for your Tours?
voci.r: Absolutely not. Please keep in mind that if during your tour you want to enter a church, a religious site or a famous attraction (Vatican Museums, Accademia Gallery, Uffizi, etc.) you must have your shoulders and knees, covered.

voci.d: Are your Private Tours accessible for people with mobility difficulties or wheelchair/scooter users?
voci.r:
Private Tours are the most comfortable option for people with walking difficulties. Being private you can move at your own pace with no rush and your driver can drive you almost anywhere. 

 

For people using a wheelchair or an electric scooter, we do not have vehicles equipped with automatic lifts. Please let us know the size and weight of your wheelchair/scooter, so we can make sure that it fits in the trunk of your vehicle, to avoid any unpleasant situations.

voci.d: Are your Small Group Tours accessible for people with mobility difficulties or wheelchair/scooter users?
voci.r: Unfortunately not! None of our Small Group Tours can be joined by people with mobility difficulties or wheelchair/scooter users; first because the used vehicles are not equipped with a lift or ramps and last but not least, because being a group tour, in respect of all the participants we have to maintain a standard pace. Surely if you contact us, we can suggest private alternatives to suit your needs.

voci.d: How much walking is involved on your Private Tours/Cruise Port Tours/Transfer Tours??
voci.r: It is totally up to you, because all our 8 passenger vehicles, have special permits/licenses to circulate almost everywhere (pedestrian areas included), so for those with walking difficulties the driver can arrange an itinerary to see the highlights, directly from the car. The best way to enjoy the historic city centers is by walking.

voci.d: How much walking is involved on your Small Group Tours?
voci.r:
Our Small Group Tours are designed to have the minimum amount of walking necessary to cover the highlights of the itinerary.

 

Our Wine Experience and our Wine & Food Experience have very limited walking with just a few steps to visit the wine cellars; the Siena & San Gimignano Tour, and the Cinque Terre tour, due to their logistics include bigger walking distances, and being a shared tour, in respect of all the participants, you have to maintain the standard pace of the group.

voci.d: I left my phone/camera/bag/etc. on the vehicle, what do I do?
voci.r: In case you left something on the vehicle, please give us a call asap, so we can do a search immediately. It is solely your responsibility at the end of the service to check carefully that you have all your belongings with you. We are not responsible for lost items, but we will do our best to find your belongings.

voci.d: I'd like to give you my feedback
voci.r: Feedback, suggestions, etc. from our guests is the best way for us to continue to improve our services, that’s why we love to hear from you.

voci.d: Can I leave a review?
voci.r: As you can see we have received hundreds of amazing reviews, and for us it is important that our guests are having a wonderful time. Your opinion is valuable and we are awaiting your feedback.

voci.d: Can I customize my Private Tour/Cruise Port Tour/Transfer Tour?
voci.r: Absolutely yes! This is one of the biggest advantages of Private Tours. You can customize all the details to suit your specific needs. The itineraries shown on our website are just examples that we have built over 25+ years of experience, to include the highlights and the most requested sites of your chosen trip.

voci.d: Can I discuss/change the itinerary, directly with the driver on the day?
voci.r:
Yes, you can decide your itinerary on the actual day of the tour, as our drivers have a thorough knowledge of sites and can create an itinerary that best suits your needs.

 

You may choose the destination/stops/activities suitable for your trip.
Please note: if you are interested in a specific attraction (museum, restaurant, winery) we highly recommend to ask us in advance to be sure about the availability.

voci.d: Can the driver give us suggestions about our itinerary?
voci.r: Your driver will be well informed and he/she will be able to give you advice according to your needs.

voci.d: I'm enjoying my time, can I extend the duration of the tour?
voci.r: We are always very flexible, so if you are enjoying your day and you want to extend the duration of your service, adding extra hours, simply ask your driver to confirm the availability and the additional cost.

voci.d: Do you follow safety measures?
voci.r: The safety of our passengers and staff has always been our priority. We want your experience to be as comfortable and safe as possible that is why, even in the post-pandemic time, we will continue to use the best safety measures.

voci.d: Do you follow social distancing rules?
voci.r:
Fortunately at this time social distancing is not required, however we want your experience to be as comfortable and safe as possible, so we will continue with all the safety measures: 

Private Services (Tours & Transfers): your party will be the only one in the vehicle, so the best in terms of comfort, safety and privacy. 

Shared Services (Small Group Tours): all the tours will be arranged using the right size vehicle, and in respect of all the actual rules.

voci.d: Do you clean your vehicles?
voci.r: Vehicles are cleaned at the end of each service by our professional cleaning team. The products we use follow the regulations settled by the Health Organizations and include the AC system, filters etc. Vehicle interiors are cleaned and disinfected paying special attention to seating areas, armrests and door handles. Vehicle exteriors are hand-washed.

voci.d: Do the venues involved on your tours apply safety measures?
voci.r: All the attractions and venues (museums, restaurants, wineries, etc.) suggested or included on our tours, strictly follow all the safety rules according to the evolution of the situation.

voci.d: Do I need to wear a facial mask?
voci.r: Currently it is not mandatory for guests and staff, to wear a protective mask.

voci.d: Is your company an Italian company?
voci.r: Yes, we are an Italian company. The main office is located in Florence Italy, and we have vehicles/drivers in the most important locations in Italy.

voci.d: Where do you offer your services in Italy?
voci.r:
Our private services are offered in/from the main locations (cities, ports, airports, stations) in Italy. 

For example, Florence and Tuscany, Livorno Port, La Spezia Port, Civitavecchia Port, Naples Port, etc.

Our small group tours depart only from Florence.

voci.d: Is your company fully insured & Licensed, as requested by the Italian Law?
voci.r:
Yes, we are. Prestige Rent is a Licensed Tour Operator & Travel Agency, authorized by the Italian chamber of commerce – REA FI 571489 – VAT 05745220482.

 

We are also a Transportation company and all of our vehicles and drivers are fully insured and have licenses and permits required by the Italian Law.

voci.d: How/when can I contact you?
voci.r:
For any questions, the best way to be in touch with us is by email or chat.

 

If you prefer, you can give us a call and our Customer Care team will be happy to assist you 7 days a week from 8am – 8pm (CET).

voci.d: Emergency numbers
voci.r: If you have a last minute problem on your trip (i.e. cancelled flight, delay, etc.) and need immediate assistance, on your confirmation voucher you will find our emergency contact numbers, available 24/24 hours.

voci.d: Different time zones
voci.r:
We are based in Italy so between you and us there could be a time gap. 

Please don’t use our emergency numbers to call us just to ask about the weather in Italy, how to dress, etc., because due to the different time zones, it may be 3:00am in Italy!

We are always very happy to assist you in any way. If it is NOT an emergency you can send us an email and we will answer you as soon as possible.

voci.d: What to do if I need more info/clarifications
voci.r: In the “Help” section on the top right hand of each page, you can find how to contact us and our FAQs where you can find many immediate answers.

voci.d: What if I lose my confirmation voucher?
voci.r: Send an email or give us a call and we will give you a copy of the voucher.

voci.d: What to do if I have a last minute problem
voci.r: We know anything can happen. Just in case you have a problem please call our emergency numbers, we’ll do our best to help you.

voci.d: What is a Private Tour of Italy?
voci.r:
We are not only a transportation company but also a fully licensed Tour Operator, we can legally arrange all-inclusive vacation packages in Italy.

 

You reserve your flight and then we will take care of all your needs, from your arrival transfer to the daily tours, the transfers between cities, local guides, entrance fees and anything you need in order to have the perfect vacation in Italy.

 

Simply let us know what type of accommodation you are interested in, and your personal tastes and we’ll do the rest.

voci.d: Which cities can I include on my Private Tour of Italy?
voci.r: It is totally up to you, simply let us know the cities you’d like to visit and we will include them on your Private Tour of Italy.

voci.d: Where do I start/finish my Private Tour of Italy?
voci.r: Wherever you want. Let us know your arrival and departure airport so we can arrange a perfect itinerary that suits your needs.

voci.d: Can you build a customized Private Tour of Italy to suit my specific needs?
voci.r:
This is exactly what we do, we create itineraries because each guest is different and has different interests.

 

Please contact us for more information on what type of experience you are looking for and we will give you the best advice according to your itinerary, we have been in the business for over 25 years.

voci.d: Which is the best season to organize a Private Tour in Italy?
voci.r:
Unfortunately, there is no correct answer to this question. The tourist season normally starts from April to October (with a slight decline in August due to the hot temperature) but it depends on you and your own interests.

 

If you like the beach, August could be the best time for you. If you are interested in wine, it would be better to come in the middle of September beginning of October because that is the harvest time. 

During Christmas, it could be perfect if you like cold temperatures and would like to avoid the large crowds.

In other words, it all depends on what you prefer. When you book a private tour you decide all the details.

voci.d: I've seen a similar tour on TripAdvisor/Viator/GetYourGuide. Is it the same tour?
voci.r: Probably yes! Our tours are very popular on online Travel Agencies and booking websites, and we are proud to work with them.

voci.d: Why should I book a tour directly with you?
voci.r:
With no intermediaries, you communicate directly with us so if you need to make any changes, it would be much simpler and faster.

We are a well-trusted company, we cannot compare to a big travel company. Booking directly allows us to dedicate more time and attention to you.

voci.d: What is a small group tour?
voci.r: It is a shared tour, you are with other participants. All the details of the service (max group size, departure time/location, itinerary, duration, inclusions, price per person) are clearly specified on the tour page and cannot be modified.

voci.d: Who will guide my small group tour?
voci.r:
Our wine tours are led by an English-speaking driver (usually certified sommelier) with extensive knowledge of the Tuscan wine culture/region or by a driver plus a separate expert guide. In both cases at each winery, the tour and tasting will be given by experts.

 

 

Our small group tours to Siena and San Gimignano or the Cinque Terre, usually are led by a licensed tour guide and a separate driver. Occasionally, when the number of participants is less than 9 people, they can be guided by a driver who is also a certified guide.

voci.d: I'm leaving at the end of my small group tour, can I bring my luggage?
voci.r: Yes, your luggage can be stored in the vehicle. Please advise us at the time of booking.

voci.d: I like the itinerary of one of your small group tours, can I book it privately?
voci.r: Sure! Contact us and we will provide you with all the options.

voci.d: Can I join a small group tour if travelling with an infant?
voci.r:
We have 2 small group tours (Wine Experience in Tuscany and Wine & Food Experience in Tuscany) where infants and toddlers are not allowed. 

If you are traveling with infants and you are interested in wine, please check our Private Wine Tours or contact us for suggestions.

Infants can join our Siena, San Gimignano and the Tuscan countryside tour for free.

voci.d: Why infants are not allowed on your small group wine tours?
voci.r:
Please don’t misunderstand, we are the most kid-friendly company in the world. 

Unfortunately, after a few bad experiences of infants and toddlers crying, we had several different complaints from our guests and we decided to put an age limitation. 

If you are traveling with infants and you’re interested in wine, please check our private wine tours or contact us for suggestions.

voci.d: What is a Private Tour?
voci.r: Private means just for you, so your party will be the only one in the vehicle. Customize all the details of your service to perfectly suit your needs. A private service is the best in terms of safety, comfort, flexibility, and privacy.

voci.d: From which city do you run your Private Tours?
voci.r: Currently from Florence & Tuscany. If you don’t find your destination, please contact us!

voci.d: Where do I start/finish my Private Tour?
voci.r: Our private services are door-to-door so the pick-up/drop-off can be customized to suit your needs. We can pick you up at your accommodation (hotel, apartment, villa) or wherever you want.

voci.d: At what time do you suggest we start our Private Tour?
voci.r:
We suggest you to meet your driver at 9:00am. On each tour page under the tab time/location, you can find the suggested departure time for the specific tour. 

You can customize it to suit your needs.

voci.d: What is a Private Cruise Port Tour (or Private Shore Excursion)?
voci.r:
It is a Private Tour with pick up and drop off at your cruise ship.

Private means just for you, so your party will be the only one in the vehicle. You can customize all the details of your service to perfectly suit your needs. A private service is the best in terms of comfort, flexibility, and privacy.

voci.d: From which Ports of call do you run your Private Cruise Port Tours?
voci.r: Our most important Italian ports of call are Civitavecchia (Rome), Livorno (Florence), Naples, La Spezia, etc.

voci.d: Do you offer discounts if we book 2 or more ports with you?
voci.r: Yes we do, please let us know the ports you are interested in so we can reply with our best offer.

voci.d: Where do I start/finish my Private Cruise Port Tour?
voci.r: Our private cruise port tours include pick up and drop off directly at your ship.

voci.d: At what time do you suggest we start our Private Cruise Port Tour?
voci.r: We suggest you to meet your driver at 8:00am. You may choose the time you prefer.

voci.d: I'd like to be picked up earlier than 8:00am to avoid the crowds while disembarking
voci.r: That sounds great! Before asking for an earlier pickup time, double-check with your cruise company if you’ll be able to disembark at that specific time. Your ship arrival time and your disembarkation time may differ.

voci.d: My ship will not dock due to unforeseen circumstances (weather, itinerary change, etc.)
voci.r: If due to unforeseen circumstances your ship will not show up at the port, no charges will be made. If you have prepaid your tour you will be refunded.

voci.d: My cruise has been cancelled, can I cancel my booking for free?
voci.r:
Yes, no penalty will be applied. 

Our super-friendly cancellation policy allows you to cancel your booking for free up to 24 hours prior to departure time.

voci.d: Will I return to my ship on time?
voci.r:
None of our clients have ever missed the ship, we have been arranging private cruise port tours for over 25 years. 

If you do miss your ship because of us, we will pay for all the expenses, dinner and overnight stay, as well as arranging your transfer to the next port of call.

voci.d: Why missing the ship is an extremely rare event?
voci.r:
You could miss the ship for different reasons such as the closure of the road to the port due to an accident, etc., or vehicle breakdown. 

In case of the road closure, the buses of the ship will have the same problem on the highway and the ship will not depart because they will wait until the last bus will come. 

Having a smaller car is easier to find alternative routes than a big bus.

In case of vehicle breakdown, our company uses new Mercedes Benz vehicles, continuously monitored, and maintained. Our tours are very popular so every day we have many vehicles at the Livorno port that could be used as a backup in case of emergency.

voci.d: What is the difference between your Private Tours and the Private Tours offered by the Cruise Company?
voci.r:
The price of a Private Tour offered by the cruise ship company could be up to 3/4 times more expensive than the same tour we offer. 

 

We are 100% sure, if you find a tour from the cruise company that has the same value, itinerary, high quality as us, for an equal or less amount, we will give you the tour for free.

voci.d: What is the difference between your Private Tours and the standard Big Bus Tours offered by the Cruise Company?
voci.r:
The difference is that with our private tours, you will have approx. 40% more time for sightseeing, compared to a slow-moving big bus tour, with 50+ other guests.
At the beginning and at each stop you have to wait for all the participants, you have to follow an exact itinerary, including sites you are not interested in, you have to consider restroom stops on the highway, longer driving times, bigger walking distances between the places where big buses are allowed to drop you off at the heart of Florence, where the attractions are located.

Second, the price, because if you are a party of 4/6 people, our price for a private service could be even cheaper than the total amount to pay for a big group bus tour.

Last but not least, with our private driver and vehicle, just for your party, you have complete control of your day, and you can customize pick up time, duration, itinerary, etc. and focus just on your interests. You are free to move at your own pace, making it the best in terms of safety, comfort, flexibility, and privacy, and you will maximize your short time ashore.

voci.d: What is a Private Transfer?
voci.r:
The best and fastest way to move from point A to point B, without crowding and wasting time.

 At the requested time, your private driver will pick you up to drive you directly to your final destination. 

We offer our service in the most important cities/airports/train stations/ports in Italy. A private transfer is the best as far as safety, comfort, flexibility and privacy.

voci.d: What is a Private Transfer Tour?
voci.r: It is the same as a private transfer, with the addition of a stop en route for sightseeing/shopping/tasting/etc. This way you have the chance to maximize your time here in Italy, with an excellent level of safety, comfort, flexibility, privacy, etc., you can get only with a private service.

voci.d: From which City/Location do you run your Transfers/Transfer Tours?
voci.r: From the most important Italian Airports, Train Station, Ports and cities, such us Florence (& Tuscany), Rome, Naples (Amalfi Coast), Milan, Venice, etc. If you don’t see your destination, please get in touch, because being Private Tours we can arrange it according to your needs.

voci.d: Where/how do I meet my driver?
voci.r:
Different airport/train stations/ports have different meeting points, so you will find the exact directions on your confirmation email/voucher.

Just to give you an idea, below you can find a general rule of where to meet your driver, depending on your pick up place:

Hotel – in the lobby

Private Apartment – close to the main door, in the street

Airport – after customs, where you exit from the gate to enter the public lounge

Train Station – each train station has its meeting point, clearly specified on your voucher

Port – close to the ship gangway, it all depends on where you dock

For airports/stations/ports pick up, your driver will be holding a sign with your name on it.

voci.d: Will my driver be English speaking?
voci.r: All of our drivers are fluent in English.

voci.d: Will my driver also be my tour guide?
voci.r: Although our past clients on their reviews called our drivers “guides or driver-guides”, according to the Italian law, all drivers are not allowed to leave their vehicle and walk/enter with clients to/in museums/churches/attractions. If you prefer to add a local guide let us know at the time of booking and we can reserve this service for an additional cost.

voci.d: Do you suggest to hire a local guide too?
voci.r: How much a guide can enrich your experience depends on the itinerary, and the attractions you would like to see. If you are in doubt, let us know what kind of experience you are looking for and we will give you our opinion.

voci.d: Can I request a specific driver?
voci.r: Fortunately many times we receive requests for a specific driver from friends and relatives of our past clients, Tripadvisor readers, etc. We do our best to assign you the requested driver, but as you can imagine sometimes it is not possible, because there are many things that may change from the moment you book to the day of the tour. Please be reassured that all of our drivers are fully licensed and trained to be friendly, informative and safe.

voci.d: What type of vehicle do you use for Private Services?
voci.r: Our specially selected fleet of luxury air-conditioned vehicles includes Mercedes Sedans, Mercedes Executive sedans, Mercedes vans and Mercedes Minibuses, such us, Mercedes E class, Mercedes S Class, Mercedes V class, Mercedes Sprinter, etc. All our vehicles are perfectly maintained and fully equipped.

voci.d: What type of vehicle do you use for your Small Group Tours?
voci.r: We use air conditioned and fully equipped minibuses with free wi-fi on board.

voci.d: What type of private vehicle will be assigned to my party?
voci.r:
As a general rule we use a Mercedes E class sedan for parties of up to 3 adults (or 4 people including kids), a Mercedes V class Mpv for parties of 4 to 6/7 people and a Mercedes Sprinter for parties of 7/8 people.
On request and at an additional price, the Mercedes E class sedan can be upgraded to a Mercedes S class. For parties of 9 or more people, we will use one of our minibuses/buses according to your party size. More details are on our car fleet page. Please note: according to our availability, you may benefit from a free upgrade, and have a bigger vehicle that has more room than the one you booked.

voci.d: Are your vehicles fully insured?
voci.r: All our vehicles are fully insured as requested by the Italian law. Vehicles up to 8 passengers have a special license, necessary to drive almost everywhere (pedestrian areas included), like a taxi. In addition to that, being Prestige Rent, a limousine company and a Tour Operator too, our guests are also covered by the special insurance policy for Tour Operators.

voci.d: Do your vehicles have restrooms on board?
voci.r: Unfortunately not! However for Small Group Tours, most of the rides between places, are shorter than 1 hour. Obviously, you can always request a stop in case of an emergency. As for Private Services, being the only party in the vehicle, you have complete control of the day, including stops for restrooms too.

voci.d: Do you provide baby or booster seats?
voci.r: For Private Services only, we can provide them, however to be sure about the availability, please ask us at the time of the booking along with the details, to choose the right size/model, according to the Italian law.

voci.d: Do you run an affiliate program?
voci.r: Yes we do, and if you want to join it and earn extra money, please send us an email.

voci.d: How does your affiliate program work?
voci.r: It is very easy! You promote our services in your favorite way, and for each sale generated by your contacts you will earn a commission.

voci.d: Do I need my own web site to promote your services?
voci.r:
You don’t need your own website to join our affiliate program. Promote our services through social networks (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Google+), e-mails, blogs, mobile apps, newsletters, etc.

 

As soon as a visitor goes through our website with your link/code, we can track the visit and in case they purchase, the commission will automatically be assigned to you.

 

The more website traffic you send us (click-through rate) and that website traffic converts visitors into buyers (conversion rate), the more money you will earn.
